title: OAuthLib: Token grants can use attacker-supplied client_id for authorization after authenticating a different client…
description: OAuthlib contains a vulnerability in its token grant handlers where an authenticated low-privilege client can supply a different client_id in the token request body, causing grant and scope validation to be performed under that other client identity. This affects the client_credentials and password grant flows. The flaw allows a low-privilege client to obtain tokens with scopes or grant types assigned to a higher-privilege client if the application validator authorizes based on the attacker-supplied client_id argument. The issue is fixed in OAuthlib version 5.5.0.
